comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Unfortunately I experienced this too. It only seems to happen when using the `ts/multilingual-e5-small` model, though. Sometimes I consistently get the same error as above (even after restarting the typesense container), but mostly if I start from a clean docker volume, using the curl example above (except for the model change), the curl call hangs and Typesense container log shows:
```
[E:onnxruntime:, sequential_executor.cc:494 ExecuteKernel] Non-zero status code returned while running Add node. Name:'/embeddings/Add' Status Message: /root/.cache/bazel/_bazel_root/45fa99e3ef9c0d8b8591cceacfe70dd5/execroot/__main__/external/onnx_runtime/onnxruntime/core/providers/cpu/math/element_wise_ops.h:666 onnxruntime::Broadcaster::Broadcaster(gsl::span<const long int>, gsl::span<const long int>) largest <= 1 was false. Can broadcast 0 by 0 or 1. 6 is invalid.
```
Substituting `ts/paraphrase-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2` and `ts/all-MiniLM-L12-v2` work fine.
